# P&M Apparel

> Woman-owned, third-generation custom apparel company in Polk City, Iowa, serving Ankeny and the Des Moines metro since 1987. Screen printing, embroidery, digital printing (DTF), fusion transfers, sublimation, promotional products, free online team stores, live event printing, and print-on-demand school apparel via Iowa On Demand. Ships nationwide and internationally.

Contact: (515) 984-7740, info@pmapparel.com, 1100 S 5th St, Polk City, IA 50226. Hours: Monday-Friday 8am-5pm.

Key facts: 12-piece recommended minimum for screen printing ($30 per-screen charge below minimum; 1-piece minimums for embroidery and digital printing). Two automatic screen printing presses (11-head and 7-head), a 4-color manual press, and a mobile press for live events; up to 10 colors. Standard turnaround 8-10 business days after art approval (up to 12 in peak season) for screen printing, embroidery, and digital printing; sublimation runs 3-4 weeks. Rush available (same day if in stock). Quotes within 24 hours. One-time $35 embroidery setup. Custom art $100/hr, first 30 minutes free with production orders. Customer-supplied garments welcome with waiver. Free online team stores (Chipply). Pantone matching available. Brands: Gildan, Bella+Canvas, Comfort Colors, Carhartt, Nike, Adidas, Under Armour.

## Blog
- [how to lower your per-shirt cost](https://www.pmapparel.com/blog/how-to-lower-per-shirt-cost/): Seven real levers that bring your custom apparel price down, straight from the people who quote the jobs. No coupon codes, just math.
- [screen printing vs digital printing (dtf): how to choose](https://www.pmapparel.com/blog/screen-printing-vs-dtf/): The honest decision guide: when screen printing's bulk economics win, when digital printing's one-piece minimum and full-color detail win, and how to pick for your order.
- [embroidery vs screen printing for company apparel](https://www.pmapparel.com/blog/embroidery-vs-screen-printing/): Polos and jackets or staff tees? A practical guide to when stitched logos beat printed ones, what setup actually costs, and how minimums differ.
- [what is sublimation actually good for?](https://www.pmapparel.com/blog/what-is-sublimation-good-for/): Sublimation makes prints you can't feel, but only on the right garments. Where it shines, where it fails, and what to use instead.
- [what does custom apparel cost? how our quotes work](https://www.pmapparel.com/blog/how-quotes-work/): We quote every job individually. Here's exactly what moves the number: quantity breaks, color counts, setup fees, art time, and what happens after you say yes.
- [it's just a shirt](https://www.pmapparel.com/blog/its-just-a-shirt/): An ode to the easy stuff: why keeping the 'it's just a shirt' mentality keeps our heads cool and your order fixable.
- [it's not just a shirt](https://www.pmapparel.com/blog/its-not-just-a-shirt/): An ode to the hard stuff: the teams, businesses, battles, and fundraisers a shirt can carry and why we care so much.
- [what your print location says about you](https://www.pmapparel.com/blog/what-your-print-location-says-about-you/): Chest, sleeve, full back, pocket, hood: a tongue-in-cheek personality read on every print placement, plus why unique locations make gear people keep wearing.
- [shirts in sync](https://www.pmapparel.com/blog/shirts-in-sync/): Why marching band season is a graphic designer's dream: set lists, costume inspiration, and special effects from glow-in-the-dark to 3D puff.
